text: My first correction to PAWL-034 AC3 over-reached: I argued a transitive-clean import graph closes AC2 completely, but that conflates internal/render's graph with the binary's. os/exec is linked into cmd/pawl via internal/gitutil and internal/harness, and internal/cli is in this spec's Module line, so an interface value passed in reaches git or the network with render's graph clean. Added AC12 constraining the entry-point signature to concrete types; AC2 is closed by AC3 and AC12 together.
